sentences.text:
Petitioner
 Kumar Bagh
 Mr.Arijeet Mishra, Advocate
This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

This is an application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Jeypore Mahila P.S. Case No.02 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No.31 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M.,
Jeypore for offences punishable under sections 376(2)(n)/506/454 of the Indian Penal Code.
The petitioner moved an application for bail before the Court of learned Sessions Judge, Koraput at Jeypore, which was rejected on 21.03.2023.

entities.text: Court of learned Sessions Judge, Koraput at Jeypore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Considering the submission made by the learned // 2 // counsel for the petitioner is that the petitioner is in judicial custody since 05.01.2023 and charge sheet has been submitted under sections 376(2)(n)/506/454 of the Indian Penal Code and the victim is a married lady who is having four children and she appears to be a consenting party and stayed with petitioner for twenty days and after hearing learned counsel for the State who placed the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim, I Asish Bagh @ Ashish vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33582309/
1 am inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
Let the petitioner be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing bail bond of Rs.50,000.00 (rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court in seisin over the matter with further terms and conditions as the learned Court may deem just and proper including the conditions that the petitioners shall appear before the learned trial Court on each date to which the case would be posted for trial.
Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.

sentences.text: The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.

( S.K. Sahoo) Judge Sipun Asish Bagh @ Ashish vs State Of Odisha .... Opp.
